'''Tesser''' was an [[X'Ting]] who lived before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was the broodmate and brother of [[Jesson Di Blinth]], a member of the X'Ting [[Hive Council]]. He [[Death/Legends|died]] in a cave while searching for the Royal X'Ting eggs. Jesson and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] found his body tied to a rock, presumably so that he would not fall to the carnivorous [[Worm/Legends|worms]] that inhabited the caves if he passed out.<ref name="TH" />
